# pheno-mcp-router

Generic FastMCP router wrapping a backend HTTP endpoint with tier
allowlisting, payload sanitization, response allowlisting, and
structured logging.

## Install

```bash
pip install pheno-mcp-router
```

## Usage

```python
from pheno_mcp_router import McpRouter

router = McpRouter(
    name="dispatch-minimax",
    backend_url="http://localhost:20128/v1/chat/completions",
)
router.add_tier("minimax", {"model": "minimax-m2p7"})
router.serve()
```

## Scaffold a new MCP server

```bash
pheno-mcp-router init my-mcp-server
# creates ./my-mcp-server/{pyproject.toml,src/my_mcp_server/__init__.py,server.py}
```

## Security model

- **Tier allowlist** (must `add_tier` first) — never bypass
- **Payload sanitize_keys** (default: model, messages, temperature, max_tokens) — strip everything else
- **Response allowlist** (default: id, model, choices, usage) — strip everything else
- **max_message_bytes / max_response_bytes** — prevent DoS
- **structured logging** — every dispatch logs router, tier, bytes
